title: Zikr Ghame Hussain se Mehfil Saji Rahi
body:
Zikr ghame Hussain se mehfil saji rahi
Gul hogaya chiraag magar roshni rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaime furaath se toh hatae gaye magar
Abbase naamdar ki tyewari chadi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ke baad zeest mein kya dilkashi rahi
Laila tamam umr yehi sonchti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas lene aaye joh maidan ki Raza
Zainab bus apne baazuon ko dekhti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashke ghame Hussain ka tootah na silsila
Roomale fatema mein hamesha nami rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Balwe mein bey rida sare Zainab ko dekh kar
Allah jaane kaise qayamat ruki rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Adam se ae sayeed risaalat ma-aab tak
Har daur mein zaroorate nadey Ali rahi
